description: N.D. Rajanetti & Another v. Harischandra P. Jayasooriya N.D. Rajanetti & Another v. Harischandra P. Jayasooriya View More before A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: N.D. Rajanetti & Another v. Harischandra P. Jayasooriya N.D. Rajanetti & Another v. Harischandra P. Jayasooriya View More
keywords: Plaintiff sought a declaration that certain defendants held land in trust for him. District Court found a trust existed based on an informal agreement. Held - the Court set aside the judgment, finding the District Court failed to properly apply the Trust Ordinance, improperly admitted an informal agreement as evidence, and failed to evaluate whether the arrangement constituted a trust rather than a mere agreement to sell; therefore, case remitted for fresh hearing.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
